result.finding: Assessed 16 CWE rules in Code Quality: 2 FOUND, 14 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed existing application source, service contracts, model/configuration and project compile items; generated proxies excluded as primary findings.
Existing source assessed, not a change-set review. Static analysis only; no exploit or deployment verification.

dotnet list package --include-transitive --format json failed because Microsoft.WebApplication.targets was unavailable. Legacy packages.config inventories and csproj HintPath versions were used. No restored complete transitive dependency graph was obtained.

GitHub REST advisories query succeeded for EntityFramework 6.1.3, Microsoft.AspNet.WebApi.Client 5.2.3 and Newtonsoft.Json 6.0.4 (NuGet); one current advisory and one withdrawn duplicate returned; no next page. Coverage excludes unknown transitive dependencies, .NET Framework/Windows components, and bundled JavaScript not represented by these NuGet coordinates.

Unused UWP helpers are present in source but absent from the WinForms Compile items; their presence alone is not evidence of exploitable runtime deserialization, upload, or singleton vulnerabilities. NOT_FOUND means no confirmed match in the scoped static review, not proof of absence.
CWE severity values are prescribed assessment priorities, not CVSS exposure ratings. Related CWE entries may describe the same root cause; finding totals are not independent exploit counts.

Read-only specialist independently corroborated dependency/source locations but did not certify existing-source CWE findings under its changes-only/exploitability remit. Path containment and resource-lifetime entries describe static weaknesses: attacker-observable file disclosure, deployed unauthorized access, and exploitable resource exhaustion were not demonstrated. They must not be interpreted as verified remote exploits.

values.name: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
values.description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the resource is no longer needed.

evidence.explanation: CatalogView.SetCatalogItems opens a GDI+ Image via Image.FromFile at line 58 and derives a thumbnail at line 59, but never disposes the original image, including on exceptions. Image.FromFile retains its backing file lock until disposal. Repeated catalog/filter reloads can retain file handles and native image resources until finalization and degrade client availability. Thumbnail retention is not used as the basis of this finding. No remote exploitation or measured exhaustion was demonstrated.

values.confidence_scope: Observed source pattern only; impact and deployment conditions remain unverified.

values.name: Missing Release of File Descriptor or Handle after Effective Lifetime
values.description: The product does not release a file descriptor or handle after its effective lifetime has ended, i.e., after the file descriptor/handle is no longer needed.

evidence.explanation: CatalogView.SetCatalogItems opens a GDI+ Image via Image.FromFile at line 58 and derives a thumbnail at line 59, but never disposes the original image, including on exceptions. Image.FromFile retains its backing file lock until disposal. Repeated catalog/filter reloads can retain file handles and native image resources until finalization and degrade client availability. Thumbnail retention is not used as the basis of this finding. No remote exploitation or measured exhaustion was demonstrated. This is the retained-file-handle specialization of CWE-772, not a separate leak.
